scope: Static catalog (docs/datasets/index.html, docs/index.html), quality page, preview display scripts, converted_datasets/README.md, and two dataset headers with queued claims. Metadata, small JSON/YAML and HTML only; no Parquet/HDF5/MAT contents opened; no job launched.
method: Compared each status, count, download and preview statement with the audit JSONs, dataset metadata records, preview manifest, test record and backlog task statuses. Counts traced to docs/datasets/_metadata comparison_tasks.total_strides and their last_dataset_path.

status_labels.pilot: a few recordings rebuilt and matched to source
status_labels.partial: part of the study rebuilt and matched to source
status_labels.rebuilt: full planned scope rebuilt and matched to source; open science remains

claims.claim: These downloads are older conversions and have not yet been re-checked. Counts come from earlier reports.
claims.finding: True but did not distinguish legacy downloads from local rebuilt/source-checked outputs, and gave no per-dataset status or evidence link.
claims.correction: Note now states every download is legacy, unreviewed; rebuilt files are local only; links to Status by dataset. Each row gains a status label (Legacy only / Source-checked pilot / Partly rebuilt / Rebuilt, local only) linked to quality/index.html#status-<slug>; a fold defines the labels. Downloads column renamed "Legacy downloads".

claims.claim: Single count per study with no artifact named.
claims.finding: Counts are sums of comparison_tasks.total_strides in docs/datasets/_metadata/<slug>.yaml, a historical report on last_dataset_path. Mismatches: um21 14,240 counted umich_2021_phase_raw.parquet, not the Full download name umich_2021_phase_dirty.parquet (local raw footer 2,122,650 rows = 14,151 blocks); gt23 task sum 2,940 vs record total_strides 2,215, file not local; mb24 15,825 counts both stair leg views (rebuilt output 15,061); sp50 144 counts a nested converter file while the preview uses a 3-curve root file; gt21 19,519 counted the Full download name while the preview uses the clean file (17,418).
claims.correction: Header renamed "Historical count"; each cell names what it counted (Full file / local file, no download / leg views, local file / older full file, not the download / disputed: record total 2,215). Legend explains "Full file" means same name, bytes not compared.

claims.claim: Gait120 rebuild queued; UM21 extension, stair rebuild and 479-cycle recovery queued; GT24 readback queued; GT21 rebuild "is being rebuilt", force/COP readback, event/terrain checks, ramp/stair checks and bilateral pilots queued; StrokePiG full export queued.
claims.finding: backlog-refresh-20261027 records all 33 watchers stopped_incomplete with no live process and requires replacing queued/scheduled/live wording with prepared/stopped; PM-02 dispositioned every retained job with none started. GT21 reached 102 of 2,301 recordings before stopping.
claims.correction: Each queued claim reworded to "prepared but has not run" / "stopped" / "has not run"; GT21 states 102 of 2,301 recordings, run stopped. Block title changed to "Rebuild details by dataset (local outputs; runs stopped)". No "queued" remains on edited pages.

claims.claim: Rebuilding all 6,882 source recordings is queued; first Fukuchi pair scheduled behind existing work.
claims.finding: Same stopped-watcher evidence (gait120 watchers and fukuchi_first_pair watcher stopped_incomplete; refresh says do not present Fukuchi as queued/live).

claims.where: docs/quality/index.html GT23 audit row and evidence paragraph
claims.claim: Publisher raw moments are Nm, but current converters label them Nm/kg without division; moment normalization needs correction.
claims.finding: Superseded by GT23-C02 (done): Joint_Moments.csv is already N*m/kg; the earlier division proposal would double-normalize and is withdrawn. AB03 mass finding stands (force plates ~114 kg, README 113.5, local table 82.18).
claims.correction: Row now "Participant AB03 mass needs correction; moment units resolved" with both evidence links; paragraph rewritten to state units resolved, reversal of the earlier review, and the open mass issue, linking the 30 October erratum.

claims.claim: Wall of per-module summaries; "318 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped" with no date or coverage statement.
claims.finding: test_results.json is a 20 October 2026 (UTC-4) run at base be377de with uncommitted changes; 123 of the 166 tests/test_*.py files present on 31 October are not in it.
claims.correction: Tests grouped by purpose (13 fixed purposes, neutral fixed order) in one table: passed/failed/not run with scope under each label; reasons for not-run tests, per-module cases and provenance in folds. Page states the record date and that test files added after it are unassessed (round 2 removed the fixed 166/123 count, see C12). build_quality_page_data.py now records repository_test_modules so future exports report unassessed files automatically.

claims.where: preview (aggregate-preview.js) on catalog, home and quality pages
claims.claim: "Averages from a local file; its version may differ from the download." Aggregation only inside a fold.
claims.finding: Manifest records the source filename; the relation to the catalog downloads and task coverage were not shown (um21 preview covers 3 of 9 listed tasks; gt21/um21 previews use the clean file while counts describe the full file).
claims.correction: Visible lineage line: legacy unreviewed local file, whether it has the same name as the Full/Filtered download (bytes not compared) or none, tasks covered of those listed, equal-subject-weight mean and ±1 SD between subjects, and pooling of speeds/conditions. Caption repeats pooling for the chosen task. Quality coverage table now shows input file, download-name match, curves, blocks not used and tasks previewed of listed.

claims.claim: "Phase-indexed dataset with failing strides removed"; only 3 studies listed; Quick Start reads a nonexistent gtech_2021_phase.parquet.
claims.finding: clean files were filtered by a historical, unreviewed profile; 21 legacy parquet files from 8 studies are present; several clean/full pairs do not share a parent (Gait120, UM21).
claims.correction: Rewritten: three kinds of file (legacy, rebuilt in reconversion_v2, release bundle none yet), suffix meanings, every local legacy file by study with audited issues, identity warning, and examples that read the synthetic tutorial file.

claims.finding: Readers had to infer status from long paragraphs.
claims.correction: Added "Status by dataset": one card per catalog study (Downloads / Rebuilt / Checked against source / Open / Evidence), one column on phones, two from 760 px, ids status-<slug> used by catalog links.

claims.where: StrokePiG card and both catalog labels (round 2, verifier F1)
claims.claim: Source-checked pilot; Rebuilt: 2 of 151 walking recordings.
claims.finding: The two pilot outputs are native source-channel time-series exports (504 and 168 rows, components and residuals checked), not rebuilt gait cycles. PM-02 row strokepig_serial_20261020 records a completed 46/46-recording run (136 observations) that is completed_unreviewed with no source check.
claims.correction: Label changed to Legacy only on the card and both catalogs; card states no checked gait cycles, the unreviewed 46-recording run, and the 2-recording native time-series readback; label legend now says gait cycles explicitly; run-record evidence link added.

claims.claim: Every reconversion_v2/<job>/ directory is rebuilt and source-checked.
claims.finding: PM-02 dispositions: 103 completed_unreviewed, 167 superseded, 100 needing a fresh reviewed plan, 37 obsolete, 12 quarantined (419 rows); directories include plans, censuses and stopped runs.
claims.correction: Row renamed Reconstruction job records; only outputs with a completed source-readback receipt are source-checked, for that scope; links Status by dataset and the PM-02 record.

claims.claim: GT24 label without the withdrawn-fix caveat; MBLUE receipts presented without review status; hand-written test-file count.
claims.finding: GT24-C02 withdrew the ankle negation the pilot checked; MB24-F01 (reconcile MBLUE receipts) is still ready; the 166 count was already stale.
claims.correction: GT24 label reads Source-checked pilot; ankle fix withdrawn on card and both catalogs; MBLUE card says receipts are not yet independently reconciled; test note says files added after the recorded run are unassessed, without a fixed count.
